type Shape = { kind: "circle"; radius: number } | { kind: "square"; side: number };
type Result = { ok: true; value: number } | { ok: false; error: string };

function area(shape: Shape & { kind: "circle" }): number {
  return shape.radius * shape.radius;
}

function unwrap(result: Result & { ok: true }): number {
  return result.value;
}

function impossible(shape: { tag: "left" } & { tag: "right" }): never {
  return shape;
}

function ordinary(shape: { payload: string } & { payload: number; count: number }): number {
  return shape.count;
}

function optional(shape: { tag?: "left" } & { tag?: "right"; count: number }): number {
  return shape.count;
}

console.log(area({ kind: "circle", radius: 3 }), unwrap({ ok: true, value: 7 }), optional({ count: 5 }));

type MultiTag = { tag: "a" | "b"; left: number } | { tag: "c" | "d"; right: string };

function left(value: MultiTag & { tag: "a" | "b" }): number {
  return value.left;
}

function inconsistentText(value: { tag: "a" | "b" } & { tag: "c" | "d" }): never {
  return value;
}

function inconsistentNumbers(value: { tag: 1 | 2 } & { tag: 3 | 4 }): never {
  return value;
}

function overlap(value: { tag: "a" | "b"; count: number } & { tag: "b" | "c" }): number {
  const tag: "b" = value.tag;
  return value.count;
}

console.log(left({ tag: "b", left: 6 }), overlap({ tag: "b", count: 9 }));
